inventory.notes: hardwareConcurrency returns the pref when it is > 0, with no engine gate. maxTouchPoints returns the pref only when the engine is active and the caller is not System, after StealthAssertDeclarationsComplete(). Both read StaticPrefs directly from Mozilla code; each could become a one-line call into our file. The two gate differently (one checks the engine, the other does not).
